requirement: Enforce a locked PMP entry for machine-mode accesses
test_behavior: The directed test locks an NA4 entry and requires a machine-mode store without write permission to raise a store access fault.

requirement: Apply the configured read and write permissions
test_behavior: The first protected word is readable but not writable; the test checks both operations and the precise trap cause.

requirement: Reject an access that crosses a matched PMP boundary
test_behavior: An eight-byte store starts in a four-byte read-write NA4 region and must fault instead of modifying either protected or adjacent data.

requirement: Apply M-mode unlocked bypass and S/U read permissions
test_behavior: Cases 1-4 check M bypass, MPRV S/U denial, and S unmatched denial.

requirement: Apply TOR and NAPOT read/write permissions and bounds
test_behavior: Cases 5-9 check TOR read, write denial, and upper bound, plus NAPOT read and upper bound.
Cases 10-11 check overlapping deny/allow entries in both permission orders.
Case 12 requires an instruction access fault for a locked NAPOT region without X.

requirement: Apply all legal permission settings to a fully contained machine-mode access
test_behavior: Observe the three public outputs for all six legal R/W/X settings when an access is wholly inside a matching locked NA4 region.
